edits.after: When parents say “This is the best choice,” the child may hear not advice but someone deciding for them before they have had a chance to judge for themselves. When parents ask “Why can't things be as they used to be?”, the child may struggle to explain, knowing only that obeying in the old way would make them feel less and less like someone who is growing up.
edits.reason: Naturalizes preemptive occupation of judgment without changing the child's subjective perception or explanation.
edits.before: When parents say “This is the best choice,” the child may hear not advice but yet another preemptive occupation of their place in making judgments. When parents ask “Why can't things be as they used to be?”, the child may be unable to explain clearly, knowing only that obeying in the old way would make them feel less and less like a person who is growing up.

edits.after: The parent-child relationship needs to change shape: from knowing everything to letting the child choose what to share; from providing final answers to being someone the child can return to for a conversation.
edits.reason: Clarifies allowing sharing as voluntary disclosure rather than needing permission to share; retains relationship's changed role.
edits.before: The parent-child relationship needs to change shape: from knowing everything to allowing sharing; from providing final answers to becoming someone the child can return to for discussion.

edits.after: La relación necesita cambiar de forma: de saberlo todo a dejar que el hijo elija qué compartir; de ofrecer la última respuesta a ser alguien con quien pueda volver a conversar.
edits.reason: Clarifies voluntary disclosure and replaces potentially argumentative discutir in a warm return-for-discussion context.
edits.before: La relación necesita cambiar de forma: de saberlo todo a permitir que se comparta; de ofrecer la última respuesta a ser alguien con quien volver a discutir.

edits.after: They are also learning that becoming themselves means more than looking inward. It means finding a way to live in the real world and with other people, taking responsibility for the choices they make.
edits.reason: Natural prose for taking a bearable form among reality and others; preserves external world, others and responsibility.
edits.before: They are also learning that becoming oneself means more than looking inward. It means taking a form that can bear responsibility among reality and other people.

edits.after: También aprende que ser uno mismo no es buscar solo hacia dentro: es encontrar una manera de vivir en el mundo real y con los demás, asumiendo la responsabilidad de sus propias elecciones.
edits.reason: Naturalizes forma asumible entre la realidad while retaining relational responsibility.
edits.before: También aprende que ser uno mismo no es buscar solo hacia dentro: necesita tomar una forma asumible entre la realidad y los demás.

edits.after: Sometimes parents simply struggle to adjust to no longer knowing everything. Information once brought security and reassured them that they still mattered. When a child keeps secrets, parents have to step back from a familiar role: the child is beginning to live parts of their life without needing a parent to interpret them.
edits.reason: Naturalizes retreat from one role without suggesting the child withdraws from the whole relationship.
edits.before: Sometimes parents simply struggle to adjust to no longer knowing everything. Information once brought security and proved they still mattered. When a child keeps secrets, the parent encounters a retreat from one role in the relationship: the child is beginning to live in places where I do not supply the interpretation.

edits.after: A veces solo les cuesta adaptarse a no saberlo todo. La información daba seguridad y les confirmaba que seguían siendo importantes. Ante los secretos, los padres tienen que retirarse de un papel conocido: el hijo empieza a vivir partes de su vida sin necesitar que ellos se las interpreten.
edits.reason: Replaces retirada relacional ambiguity with parents stepping back from one role, not loss of all relationship.
edits.before: A veces solo cuesta adaptarse a no saberlo todo. La información daba seguridad y demostraba que seguían siendo importantes. Ante los secretos encuentran una retirada relacional: el hijo empieza a vivir en lugares donde no necesita su interpretación.

edits.after: The other response is gradually to give up on their own feelings. If my parents can always tell me “what you're really like,” perhaps I cannot trust my own judgment. Faced with a choice, the child no longer asks what they themselves see, but first guesses how their parents would explain it.
edits.reason: The child doubts their own self-knowledge, not necessarily their moral trustworthiness.
edits.before: The other is gradually to abandon their own feelings. If my parents can always tell me “what you're really like,” perhaps I really am untrustworthy. Faced with a choice, the child no longer asks what they see, but first guesses how their parents would explain it.

edits.after: La otra respuesta consiste en ir renunciando a los sentimientos propios. Si mis padres siempre pueden decirme «en realidad eres así», quizá no pueda fiarme de mi propio juicio. Al elegir, deja de preguntarse qué ve y empieza adivinando cómo lo interpretarán ellos.
edits.reason: Clarifies loss of trust in one's own judgment instead of broad unreliability of the person.
edits.before: La otra abandona gradualmente los sentimientos propios. Si mis padres siempre pueden decirme «en realidad eres así», quizá yo no sea fiable. Al elegir, deja de preguntarse qué ve y empieza adivinando cómo lo interpretarán ellos.

edits.after: Una relación puede terminar y aun así enseñar por primera vez confianza, rechazo, celos, cuidado y pérdida. Los padres no tienen que dar por hecho que toda relación intensa será para siempre, pero tampoco deberían fingir que nunca importó solo porque saben que puede acabar.
edits.reason: 不必 is need not, not must not; avoids prohibiting recognition that some relationship may last.
edits.before: Una relación puede terminar y aun así enseñar por primera vez confianza, rechazo, celos, cuidado y pérdida. Los padres no deben reconocer toda relación intensa como definitiva, ni fingir que nunca importó porque saben que puede acabar.

edits.after: If parents want to be people their children can turn to, they have to accept that they will not know every detail.
edits.reason: Naturalizes bearing not possessing whole content; retains privacy condition for a trustworthy return.
edits.before: To become someone children can return to, parents must bear not possessing the whole content.

edits.after: Si los padres quieren ser personas a quienes su hijo pueda acudir, necesitan aceptar que no conocerán todos los detalles.
edits.reason: Natural Spanish replacing possess content while retaining trustworthy availability and incomplete knowledge.
edits.before: Para ser alguien a quien pueda volver, los padres necesitan soportar no poseer todo el contenido.
